title: POST-cancel tests pin only internals; wire state and observe notification unasserted
description: python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py:285-304 (test_post_cancel_cancels_sos): after POST-cancel the test only checks sos._active; it never GETs /sos to pin the wire state {active: false, from: null, t: null} nor checks an Observe notification. A regression in cancel() (emergency.py:184-190) that cleared _active but left stale _from/_t or skipped updated_state() would pass. Follow TestSosGet/TestSosObserve conventions.
